jobs.description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually. Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second , we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time. Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake , providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange. Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training , NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference . We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem. The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day , 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines , and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second . jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord. Via applicaties, dashboarding en ad-hocanalyses moderniseer je ons datalandschap, en er is volop ruimte om te innoveren met predictive & generative AI, Data Science en Process Automation (RPA) . Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Data Integration & Analytics. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen organisatie en processen enerzijds en techniek anderzijds; Als sparringpartner voor de business til je de managementinformatie naar een hoger niveau, in innovatieve en complexe dataprojecten; Je onderhoudt en breidt onze data pipelines in SQL uit en bouwt een semantisch model ; Je voert ad-hocanalyses uit met SQL (en R) en stimuleert continue verbetering via data- en procesanalyse; Je werkt nauw samen met data professionals om de bruikbaarheid van interne en externe data te verbeteren. Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je: Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare functie én minimaal 4 jaar met SQL ; Sterk bent in SQL, DAX, dimensioneel modelleren, data vault modeling, versiebeheer en Scrum ; Uitstekend communiceert in Nederlands en Engels (woord en geschrift) en een scherpe, kritische blik hebt, daarnaast durf je tegen de business aan te schuren; Proactief en resultaatgericht bent, met een sterke drive om te blijven verbeteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen; Pré : 2+ jaar ervaring met Machine Learning-modellen, geavanceerde Power BI-kennis en ervaring met het implementeren van AI-modellen in een organisatie. Wat bieden wij? Een salaris tussen € 4.00

jobs.description: About Cantina: Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning. If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future! About the Role: We are looking for an ML Engineer to own the production inference stack for our text-to-speech (TTS) and speech recognition (ASR) models, end to end. Our research team delivers trained model checkpoints; you will productionize them as low-latency, real-time streaming services that run cost-efficiently on GPUs. The role covers the inference engines, the Kubernetes infrastructure they run on, and the performance benchmarking and accuracy validation that let us ship changes safely. You will bridge research and production, and own latency, throughput, cost and accuracy as we scale. What You’ll Do: Build and optimize streaming inference engines for TTS and ASR models, including multi-stage model pipelines. Optimize latency (time to first chunk, p50/p99) and throughput using continuous batching, CUDA Graphs, torch.compile and mixed precision. Maintain numerical parity with the reference implementation through automated accuracy regression tests, per stage and end to end. Deploy and operate GPU inference services on Kubernetes: autoscaling, containerization and infrastructure as code. Build CI/CD for model artifacts, with model versioning and reproducible releases. Own observability and performance benchmarking: p50/p99 latency, real-time factor (RTF), GPU utilization and cost per request. Partner with research to productionize new models. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning. If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future! About the Role: We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) to focus on audio model evaluation, specifically for speech generation and recognition models. This role involves designing and developing comprehensive model evaluation pipelines for both development and production environments, as well as creating automated dashboards for reporting evaluation results. As the founding member of our evaluation team, the ideal candidate is expected to leverage their experience to lead our evaluation efforts and play a key role in the future growth of the evaluation team. What You’ll Do: Designing model evaluation pipelines for models in development and production Designing user studies for subjective model evaluations. Converting requirements into measurable metrics. Designing and developing automated evaluation dashboard to see model performances and compare results. Training new models to capture new and different evaluation metrics. Communicating with the model team to help design better models based on the evaluation results. Communicating with the data team to help decide the type of data necessary to improve model performance. Communication with the product-manager to make sure product requirements are correctly measured. Help grow the evaluation team as the founding member. Lead the evaluation team in the future. jobs.title: Production & ESG Data Engineer
jobs.description: Are you passionate about data, technology and sustainability? ONE-Dyas is looking for a Production & ESG Data Engineer to ensure the accurate collection, administration and reporting of production, hydrocarbon and ESG data. You will turn complex data into reliable insights that support operational and business decisions. What will you do? · Maintain and improve databases containing validated production and ESG data. · Collect and integrate data from production sources and operated and non-operated assets. · Prepare clear monthly, quarterly and annual reports and visualizations. · Support Production, Engineering, HSE and ESG teams with data supporting operational and business decisions. · Explore opportunities for automation, machine learning and AI to improve collection, administration and reporting. · A bachelor’s level in Engineering, Accounting, Computer Science, Environmental Sciences or a related field. · Experience in data engineering or ESG reporting, preferably within the energy or oil & gas industry. · Knowledge of database management, data visualization and data governance. · Preferably experience with Python, SQL or similar tools. · Strong communication and problem-solving skills. · A proactive, independent and team-oriented approach with an interest in sustainability. Meet ONE-Dyas ONE-Dyas B.V. is the largest privately owned exploration and production company in the Netherlands. As entrepreneurs in Dutch offshore gas and oil, the company aims to make a significant contribution to the energy transition, working at the forefront of sustainability and technological innovation. Extracting gas and oil close to home contributes to the national economy, security of supply, and climate goals by employing local services, products, and know-how, reducing the reliance on imported fuels, cutting emissions, and complying to the highest environmental standards in the industry. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks)
jobs.description: Who is Artefact? Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm that transforms organizations through data and AI. With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. From our Lausanne and Zurich offices, we help leading Swiss and international companies turn data and AI into measurable results, working with the leading data platforms, including Databricks. Main Responsibilities You will design and deliver the data platforms our clients run their business and their AI on, combining hands-on engineering with client advisory. Build modern data platforms: End-to-end lakehouse architectures, mainly on Databricks, built for reliability, observability, and cost. Engineer pipelines: Batch and streaming pipelines with Python, Spark, and SQL, with data quality built in. Migrate and modernize: Move legacy warehouses and ETL to the cloud, from assessment to cut-over. Make data ready for AI: Governed data products and semantic layers that analytics and AI agents can rely on. Run it properly: Data governance, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and cost control. Advise and support: Translate business needs into roadmaps, coach junior engineers, and support proposals. Candidate Profile Engineer first, consultant second, with a track record of shipping to production. 5+ years in data engineering, including hands-on Databricks experience in production. Expert Python and SQL, with strong Spark and data modeling skills. Databricks Data Engineer Professional certification, or a commitment to obtain it within 6 months (we support you). Experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP, plus DataOps (Git, CI/CD, Terraform, testing). Strong consulting skills: requirements gathering, documentation, stakeholder management.
